measurement_note: Size is n, the matrix side length. Both diagonals contain increasing primes so the reference performs representative primality work at every position, while off-diagonal cells are irrelevant. The direct diagonal scan uses O(n sqrt(m)) time; a correct implementation that visits all n^2 cells before recognizing diagonal positions has an additional linear growth factor.
